stops.note: named the crocodile whose male snout bears a pot-shaped growth
stops.meaning: the long-snouted crocodile with a pot-shaped nose knob

stops.note: entered English via French naturalist writing on the Indian crocodilian
stops.meaning: a long, thin-snouted fish-eating crocodile native to the Indian subcontinent

current_meaning: A critically endangered, long-snouted crocodilian native to river systems of the Indian subcontinent.
